verdict: Service in the window is significantly worse than the baseline on lateness_sec, late_share.

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Bay Ridge-95 St during the affected hours: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at 36 St, where R, N, W trains run ahead of D trains bound for 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Inspect 9 Av -> 36 St for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on R, N, D, W during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so R, N, W and D slots are offset by at least half a headway at 36 St
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
